## Attendance

The March 2021 programme board was chaired by J. Whitfield. Attendees were J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, M. Chen. The board reviewed the programme position and considered the operational issues raised since the previous meeting.

## Performance

The board noted 1610 captures during March 2021. The reported backlog was 166, with 3 letters recorded for the letter bureau. These figures were noted for monitoring and follow-up through the programme.

## Items

Graders report that images exported from the hospital image index lose the eye laterality, so model results cannot be matched to the right or left eye. The board recognised that this issue affects the interpretation and reliable matching of model results. The matter requires attention before the exported images can be used with confidence for this purpose.

## Actions

The chair will circulate actions arising from the discussion. The issue concerning eye laterality will be included for follow-up, with the position to be reviewed through the programme. Performance figures, including 1610 captures, backlog 166 and 3 letters, will continue to be monitored.
